ri-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
ri-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Rhode Island's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ri-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city or town's mayor or council members, or a city or town's own published list of them.

ri-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school committee.
ri-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Rhode Island's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ri-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ri-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
ri-tribal-government.why: This app has not read the Narragansett Indian Tribe's council list yet.
ri-tribal-government.wanted: The tribe's own published list of its council.
